diagnosis.observedFloor: The failure reproduced with SMA, hooks, environment tools, sub-agents, MCP, and model switching absent. The blocker is therefore in the OpenHands/model evaluation lane rather than SMA retrieval or memory behavior.

artifactAnomaly.detail: The execution receipt recorded the journal hash before the terminal journal line was appended. rawJournalFinalSHA256 in this adjudication is the final file hash. This does not change the observed first-probe timeout.

recommendedRemediation.configuration: Create a dedicated non-default OpenHands response-canary profile with bounded LLM timeout, bounded output tokens, zero retries, thinking disabled, and the existing bare-agent restrictions. Do not mutate the shared qwen3.6-fast profile.
recommendedRemediation.instrumentation: Before deleting a failed conversation, retain content-free event-kind counts, execution status transitions, LLM request start/finish timing if exposed, and Ollama active/queued state so a timeout is attributable.
recommendedRemediation.nextGate: A new qualification requires separate acceptance and authorization. It must again require at least 128 consecutive fresh conversations and must pass before any final SMA-Q1 execution is proposed.
